def handle_client(client_socket):

        try:
            data = client_socket.recv(1024)
            if not data:

            print(f""Received data from {client_socket.getpeername()}: {data}"")

    print(f""Connected by {addr}"")
    clients.append(client_socket)

    thread.start()

for client in clients:
    client.close()

server.close()
